long_biography.plain_text:
Fakhoury’s work in Côte d’Ivoire grew from a registered architectural practice into public construction at the scale of cities. He became closely associated with President Félix Houphouët-Boigny’s building programme, culminating in the vast Basilica of Our Lady of Peace at Yamoussoukro.

After developing an architectural practice, Fakhoury combined design with project delivery in PFO Africa. The group expanded into civil works, property, water and energy, while he continued to design major landmarks. Recent works include Abidjan’s cable-stayed Cocody Bridge and the faceted Tour F, whose profile draws on an African mask.
